# `api.jobs.handling_units.get_materials`

> `GET /job/{jobDisplayId}/handlingUnit/{id}/materials` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.jobs.handling_units.get_materials(job_display_id: int, handling_unit_id: int) -> list[HandlingUnitMaterial]
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab jobs handling_units get_materials <job_display_id> <handling_unit_id>
```

``GET /job/{jobDisplayId}/handlingUnit/{id}/materials``

## Response

Returns a list of `List[HandlingUnitMaterial]`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `Optional[int]` | no | Identifier of this record; scoped to the job. |
| `materialId` | `Optional[int]` | no | Company material definition ID. |
| `materialName` | `Optional[str]` | no | Material name. |
| `materialDescription` | `Optional[str]` | no | Material description. |
| `quantityPlanned` | `Optional[float]` | no | Planned material quantity. |
| `unitCost` | `Optional[float]` | no | Cost per material unit. |
| `addedByAutoPacker` | `Optional[bool]` | no | Whether automatic packing added this material. |
| `wasteQuantity` | `Optional[float]` | no | Material quantity consumed as waste. |
| `quantity` | `Optional[float]` | no | Number of physical items or handling units. |
